_about: Fixtures for tools/uspto_trademarks.py (issue #125). Neither file is a USPTO response: no USPTO host was contacted and no key was used. Both are outputs of this repo's own code with every network request replaced by a SYNTHETIC transport failure, so the reports are deterministic. The trademark section is the part under test.

no-key-report.md.what: The full Brand Name Checker report printed by main at d46c1c1 (before issue #125), for: Nike zqxflorp --trademark-countries US,EU --variations 2, with every fetch answering the SYNTHETIC transport failure 'SYNTHETIC failure' and the check time 2026-10-23T00:00:00Z. The no key report on this branch, and the report with a placeholder key set, must equal it byte for byte.
no-key-report.md.generated_by: H3, 2026-10-23, from a clean worktree of d46c1c1

refusal-stderr.txt.what: The stderr this branch prints for the same run with USPTO_API_KEY set to the placeholder string placeholder-not-a-real-uspto-key: one NOT DOCUMENTED refusal note per name, never the key.
